candidates.incident: Accounting checks could be green while the physically materialized Accounting Coverage artifact still contained reusable mechanism gaps or unmatched canonical events.
candidates.boundedCause: Current-state tracking, factual earned-income authority, reference analytics, settlement classification, and physical publication are different layers; treating any one of them as completion can overstate accounting closure.
candidates.fix: Bind factual tracking to canonical current-state evidence mechanism by mechanism, keep Reference APR analytics non-authoritative, remove redeemed positions only from current inventory while preserving history, link explicit settlements without granting new income authority, and require the live main Accounting Coverage artifact as the closure proof.
candidates.observedResult: The live Accounting Coverage registry now classifies all 50 mechanism instances with zero reusable coverage gaps and zero unmatched canonical events, while explicit settlement links remain diagnostic and non-authoritative for period income.
candidates.lessonCandidate: Treat accounting closure as a physical-artifact property, not a green-workflow claim: promote mechanisms only from factual tracking evidence, keep Reference APR non-authoritative, reconcile settlements explicitly, and close only when live Accounting Coverage has zero reusable gaps and zero unmatched canonical events.
candidates.epistemicNote: Verified engineering association across the accounting repair sequence; it records the observed production pattern and authority boundaries, not a causal claim about every future accounting incident.
